item.title: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security
item.description:
📝 In May 2026, the PHP Foundation created the Ecosystem Security Team, which works alongside the PHP security team on triage, coordination, and hardening. Alexandre Daubois joined the PHP Foundation in July to help the PHP security team triage, handle, and fix security reports and Daniel Scherzer joined in September to take on hardening work. The growth of AI-assisted research also means the PHP security team receives far more reports than before.
🔗 Read more: https://thephp.foundation/blog/2026/10/21/todays-php-security-release-and-how-were-strengthening-php-security/

item.title: Oregon lawmakers approve money to buy an iconic waterfall listed on Redfin
Eight Bits of Trust; eMudhra's CA keys cracked in milliseconds
item.description:
📝 So the whole thing, every certificate those CAs could ever issue, every client that trusted them, rested on eight bits. Chrome made the point that because Chrome enforces Certificate Transparency, and no TLS certificates chaining to these CAs ever showed up in CT, no forged certificate could have been trusted by default in Chrome. So the fact that eMudhra and Sectigo have revoked these intermediates doesn't help them at all.
🔗 Read more: https://scotthelme.co.uk/eight-bits-of-trust-emudhras-ca-keys-cracked-in-milliseconds/

item.title: The No Kings Takedown Is Why You Shouldn't Rent Your Megaphone from Zuck
item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
item.description:
📝 Like many online services, Muse has allowed users to share searches, conversations, images, and similar content with other people. As a result, researchers from security firm Claroc said they were able to enumerate 6,800 links Muse users created for sharing conversations with others. People have the ability to share specific Muse artifacts, which creates a page that can be accessed by those with the link.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/meta-muse-exposes-users-personal-and-business-secrets-when-they-share-conversations/
